title: [P1][catalog,feedback] Catalog merge has no success confirmation
goal: catalog-manager.tsx:226-236's merge onDone handler (setMerging(false); setSelectedIds([])) just closes the merge UI and lets the revalidated list quietly drop the merged row -- there's no 'Merged successfully' feedback, unlike Settings' wipe flow which shows an explicit <Alert tone='success'>Demo data wiped.</Alert> (data-tools-panel.tsx:57,97). The catalog journey doc calls this a 'destructive-feeling action' that needs resolution feedback; currently the only signal is the row disappearing.
in_scope: Surface a brief success Alert (matching the pattern already used in data-tools-panel.tsx) after a successful merge in catalog-manager.tsx.
out_of_scope: Adding an undo affordance for merges -- not requested by the audit finding; success feedback only.

Changing the merge flow's existing preview-based confirm UI (already a deliberate, documented design choice per S-69's ledger) -- this story only adds post-merge feedback, not pre-merge confirmation changes.
acceptance: After a successful catalog merge, a brief success Alert confirms the merge, matching the existing pattern used by Settings' wipe flow, instead of the merged row silently disappearing with no feedback.
invariants: The success feedback must not block or delay the UI update -- the merged row should still disappear promptly; the Alert is additive, not a gate.
